newsitem.title: USA: SEC suspends trade in Historic Hotel.
newsitem.headline: SEC suspends trade in Historic Hotel.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission suspended trading Thursday in Historic Hotel Holdings Inc because of questions raised about a lack of current and accurate information concerning its stock.
The suspension went into effect at 0930 EDT/1330 GMT and lasts until 1159 EDT/1559 GMT on April 23, the regulatory agency said in a statement.
Trade was suspended in the stock because of concerns raised about the accuracy and adequacy of the Lake Park, Fla's., alleged ownership of, and plans to renovate or acquire, a hotel, SEC said.

Other questions arose regarding the market in which the securities are traded and the company's alleged acquisition of a company "purportedly" engaged in a business connected to the oil and gas industry, the commission said.
